blocks.title: Damped oscillations
blocks.text: Jab mukhtalif rukawat wali forces (resistive forces, jaise hawa ki mazahmat aur ragar) ki wajah se oscillation ka amplitude ghatta jaye to inhen damped oscillations kehte hain, aur un rukawat wali forces ko damping forces kehte hain.

Hum ne parha ke ideal (misali) free oscillation mein jhoolte jism ki kul mechanical energy constant rehti hai, jaise mass-spring system, daire mein harkat aur simple pendulum mein. Lekin asal zindagi mein hawa ki mazahmat (air resistance) aur ragar (friction) jaisi forces energy ko zaya (dissipate) karti hain. In ki wajah se amplitude waqt ke saath aahista aahista kam hota hai aur aakhir jism ruk jata hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text:
Light damping (halki damping): energy aur amplitude aahista aahista kam hote hain; jism rukne se pehle kai dafa jhoolta hai. Playground ka jhoola is ki sab se achhi misal hai.
Heavy damping (bhari damping): jism jhoolta nahi aur rukne (mean position par aane) mein bohat zyada waqt leta hai. Misal: gaarhe tel (thick oil) mein duba pendulum, jis par tel bohat zyada rukawat dalta hai.
Critical damping: jism baghair jhoole sab se kam waqt mein equilibrium position par wapas aa jata hai. Misal: car ke shock absorbers.

blocks.alt: Teen curves aik hi displacement se shuru: halki damping (light) ka neela curve O ke gird jhoolta hai aur amplitude ahista ghatta hai; critical damping ka hara curve sab se jaldi O par pahunchta hai aur paar nahi jata; bhari damping (heavy) ka surkh curve bohat ahista O ki taraf aata hai.
blocks.caption: Halki, critical aur bhari damping (asal graph; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon jism ek hi jagah se chhore gaye hain. Light damping mein jism kai dafa jhoolta hai. Critical damping mein woh baghair jhoole sab se kam waqt mein O par aa jata hai, is liye gari ke shock absorbers isi ke qareeb banaye jate hain. Heavy damping mein bhi jhoolna nahi hota, lekin wapsi bohat aahista hoti hai, jaise gaarhe tel mein pendulum. (Yeh graph kitab mein nahi; yeh syllabus ke 'light, critical aur heavy damping ka graph banayein' wale hisse ke liye hai.)

Misal: ek larki jhoole par jhool rahi hai (Fig. 14.14). Damping ki wajah se jhoola har dafa thora kam jhoolta hai aur aakhir ruk jata hai. Damped oscillation ka graph Fig. 14.15 mein hai. Isi tarah jhoolte simple pendulum ka amplitude aahista aahista zero ho jata hai, aur thartharate tuning fork ko ungli se chhoone par us ki awaz jaldi khatam ho jati hai: yeh sab damped oscillation ki misalein hain.

blocks.alt: Jhoole par bethi larki ke do lamhe, koi dhakka nahi de raha: jhoola khud aage peeche jhoolta aur ahista ahista ruk jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.14: Jhoole ki damped oscillation (kitab ki Figure 14.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: O se waqt ke muqable displacement. Curve time axis ke gird jhoolta hai aur har jhool pichhli se chhoti hai; oopar neeche do dashed curves tang hota ghera (envelope) banate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.15: Damped oscillation ka graph (kitab ki Figure 14.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Car ke suspension system ke shock absorbers (Fig. 14.16) damped oscillation ka amali (practical) istemal hain. Oonchi neechi, kharab sarak par car spring ki wajah se bohat zyada uchhalti; shock absorbers in faltu jhoolon (excessive oscillations) ko damping se jaldi khatam kar dete hain, taa ke musafiron ka safar aaramdeh rahe.

blocks.alt: Gari ka pahiya (wheel) suspension ke baazuon aur shock absorber se jura hai; shock absorber ke gird coil spring lipta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.16: Gari ka suspension nizam (kitab ki Figure 14.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Car ke suspension system mein critical damping kyun pasand ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Critical damping car ke dhanche ko baghair jhoole sab se kam waqt mein apni jagah (equilibrium) par le aati hai. Is se car baar baar uchhalti nahi, safar aaramdeh rehta hai aur suspension agle jhatke (bump) ke liye foran tayyar ho jata hai.

items: Damping: rukawat wali forces amplitude ko waqt ke saath kam karti hain.
Light (kai dafa jhoolta), critical (sab se jaldi wapsi, jhoolna nahi), heavy (bohat aahista wapsi).
